sentences.text:
"1) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding the opposite parties concerned to take the necessary action regarding the grievance of the petitioner raised in her application contained in Annexure No.1 to this writ petition and also provide the fair and proper compensation of land and construction made on land Gata No.847, situated in village Bighapur Kala, Tehsil Bighapur, District Unnao,
to petitioner only according to the revenue records in the interest of justice."
(3) Counsel for the petitioner has pointed out that in similar matters this Court have been pleased to pass an order directing Representation to be made by the petitioner.

(4) Learned Counsel appearing for the State-respondents on the basis of instructions dated 05.07.2024 sent by the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Unnao, has stated that the land of the petitioner was not found to have been affected by the Acquisition as per the enquiry conducted by the Tehsildar, Bighapur, on the spot a report of which was submitted on 02.07.2024.
(5) The instructions are kept on record.

(6) This writ petition is finally disposed of with a direction to the petitioner to make a Representation before the Opposite party no.4 i.e. Competent Authority under the National Highway Act within a period of two weeks from today.

If such Representation is made, the Opposite party no.4 shall decide the same, strictly in accordance with law, within a further period of twelve weeks' after affording opportunity of hearing to all concerned.
